gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-gf-pridi: Commanding and heavy, Dela Gothic One fills its lines with big wide forms. Pridi follows with a classic serif whose small letters stand nearly as tall as capitals, which is the pair's real hook.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads like a text serif with a big x-height, its counters spilling open and its ascenders kept stubby. Dela Gothic One earns its place big and brief.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-gf-slabo-13px: Dela Gothic One's lowercase rises almost to the height of its capitals, leaving wide channels of space for the eye to glide through. Slabo 13px settles in beneath, bookish and open.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-gf-suwannaphum: Heavy type, then woodblock tall. Suwannaphum has a high x-height and a c open like a bent paperclip, so a long stretch of its serif text stays dignified and easy to follow under Dela Gothic One.
gen-gf-delius-fs-bespoke-sans: Friendly handwriting up top, with tall stems and a plain unshaded line. Bespoke Sans brings sharp, refined sans-serif letters beneath Delius, and that crisp turn from rod-like strokes to open curves is what holds the pair together.
gen-gf-delius-fs-literata: Delius writes with a wide-open s and a line that never swells. Literata, a text serif with sturdy thin strokes and slightly heavier thick ones, carries a longer passage with a bookish, unhurried feel.
gen-gf-delius-swash-caps-fs-bespoke-sans: Relaxed, pen-and-paper capitals lead, with lowercase kept visibly short. Bespoke Sans takes over as a plain sans with generous room around its curves, so a longer passage reads crisp and refined.
gen-gf-delius-swash-caps-fs-literata: Literata offers a soft difference between fat and slim strokes in its text serif, with curved letters that stay wide open. Delius Swash Caps is best at casual, uniform-stroke charm, while Literata does the sophisticated reading.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Rope-ladder spacing, soft ends, a loose handwritten grin. Delius Unicase is best at that untapered, inviting warmth, while Be Vietnam Pro does the clean, steel-rod work of a plain sans with a high mean line.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-bespoke-sans: Relaxed handwriting with a pronounced x-height, no tapering at stroke ends. Bespoke Sans, a plain sans with a moderate lowercase, would sit comfortably a step or two smaller than Delius Unicase.
